transcript.text: Which tier is the value tier? Answer with the tier name.

args.sql:
SELECT c.tier, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.tier
ORDER BY order_count ASC

transcript.text:
The value tier is defined as the customer tier with the fewest orders. Query results show enterprise=287, plus=361, basic=552 — enterprise has the lowest order count.

FINAL ANSWER: enterprise
